Battle of El Herri.question: July saw increasing attacks on Laverdure's command and the outbreak of the _____ which significantly reduced the number of French forces based in Morocco
Battle of El Herri.fact: July saw increasing attacks on Laverdure's command and the outbreak of the First World War which significantly reduced the number of French forces based in Morocco.

Battle of El Herri.question: Henrys believed that _____ resistance was near its end and that the war would soon be over

Battle of El Herri.question: Most of the Zaian men were out of camp at the time, leaving behind the non-combatants, and _____ achieved complete surprise
Battle of El Herri.fact: Laverdure marched at 2.30 am on the morning of 13 November 1914 without informing his superiors, only leaving behind a note saying he was going to "annihilate" Hammou's camp. Laverdure's column reached El Herri at dawn and found the encampment of 100 tents.

Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages
Battle of El Herri.question: The first that many of the _____ knew of the attack was when his artillery shells began exploding amongst the tents
Battle of El Herri.fact: Most of the Zaian men were out of camp at the time, leaving behind the non-combatants, and Laverdure achieved complete surprise. The first that many of the Zaian knew of the attack was when his artillery shells began exploding amongst the tents.

Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages
Battle of El Herri.question: Laverdure had to send in his infantry to remove these _____, before looting the encampment
Battle of El Herri.fact: Laverdure had to send in his infantry to remove these Zaians, before looting the encampment.

Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages
Battle of El Herri.question: Word was passed to others and soon a force, estimated at 5,000 by the _____, was assembled
Battle of El Herri.fact: Hammou escaped in time but two of his wives were captured before the French headed back to Khénifra at around 8.30 am, leaving the looting to tribesmen of the Aït Ichkern, formerly Hammou's allies, who assumed he was now beaten. Word was passed to others and soon a force, estimated at 5,000 by the French, was assembled.

Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages
Battle of El Herri.question: These men consisted of almost the entire Zaian tribe and elements of the _____, Aït Harkat, Aït Ischak and Aït Ichkern (the latter, seeing the French falling back, had changed allegiance once more)
Battle of El Herri.fact: These men consisted of almost the entire Zaian tribe and elements of the Mrabtin, Aït Harkat, Aït Ischak and Aït Ichkern (the latter, seeing the French falling back, had changed allegiance once more).

Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages

Battle of El Herri.fact: At this point Laverdure ordered one company of his Senegalese infantry to leave the column to accompany a convoy of wounded soldiers to Khénifra. Battle of El Herri.fact: At this point Laverdure ordered one company of his Senegalese infantry to leave the column to accompany a convoy of wounded soldiers to Khénifra. Many of his other troops, seeing the Senegalese leaving, broke ranks and followed in panic.

Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages
Battle of El Herri.question: Laverdure attempted to continue his withdrawal but, just having crossed the _____ river, his rearguard was surrounded and attacked repeatedly from all sides, being quickly overrun
Battle of El Herri.fact: Laverdure attempted to continue his withdrawal but, just having crossed the Chbouka river, his rearguard was surrounded and attacked repeatedly from all sides, being quickly overrun.

Battle of El Herri.fact: French losses amounted to 218 Algerian or Tunisian Tirailleurs, 210 French soldiers and 33 French officers, 125 Senegalese Tirailleurs and 37 Moroccan Goums killed.

Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages
Battle of El Herri.question: Having secured the defences he immediately telegraphed _____ and Henrys to inform them of events, the first they had heard of Laverdure's foray
Battle of El Herri.fact: Having secured the defences he immediately telegraphed Lyautey and Henrys to inform them of events, the first they had heard of Laverdure's foray. Lyautey was briefly of the opinion that the event would cause the loss of the whole of Morocco.

Battle of El Herri.question: Lyautey was briefly of the opinion that the event would cause the loss of the whole of _____

Battle of El Herri.fact: Henrys left Fez for Meknes from which he telegraphed Lyautey promising to "strike hard and fast" so that the "Laverdure disaster" did not threaten the French position in Morocco.

Battle of El Herri.question: Henrys dispatched _____-Duplessix's Groupe Mobile to Khénifra from El Graar and ordered Lieutenant-Colonel Joseph Dérigoin to form another Groupe at Ito for mobile support
Battle of El Herri.fact: Henrys dispatched Garnier-Duplessix's Groupe Mobile to Khénifra from El Graar and ordered Lieutenant-Colonel Joseph Dérigoin to form another Groupe at Ito for mobile support. Battle of El Herri.fact: Another part of the Khénifra relief force was the 6th battalion of the 2nd French Foreign Legion who marched from Mrirt and saw action at El Hammam and along the Oum er Rbia.

Battle of El Herri.fact: Henrys, Garnier-Duplessix and Kroll were all promoted shortly after the battle in recognition of their actions to prevent the loss of Khénifra. As a show of force, Henrys led excursions from Khénifra to El Herri on 19 and 20 November.

Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages
Battle of El Herri.question: He observed many campfires and some groups of tribesmen but on the whole the _____, who had moved their main camps away from the area, kept their distance
Battle of El Herri.fact: He observed many campfires and some groups of tribesmen but on the whole the Zaian, who had moved their main camps away from the area, kept their distance. Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages

Battle of El Herri.fact: The Zaian war continued for many years after El Herri with Henrys changing tactics from negotiation and bribery to "submit or starve".

Battle of El Herri.subject: Indian Languages

Battle of El Herri.fact: One of the survivors of the battle, Jean Pichon, said that Laverdure was "haunted by the obsessive temptation" of defeating Hammou. Battle of Sidi Bou Othman.subject: Indian Languages

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In early November 1927, Ascaso and Durruti arrived in Lyon.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They also became involved in debates over the relationship between the CNT and the Spanish anarchist movement.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Their ideas were rejected by more orthodox anarchists, who accused them of "anarcho-Bolshevism".

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti and Ascaso upheld the revolutionary potential of both the proletariat and the peasantry in Spain, and believed that anarchists ought to accelerate the revolutionary process by encouraging revolutionary initiatives and staying focused on long-term goals over short-term material improvements. Buenaventura Durruti.fact: A young Argentine anarchist objected, pointing out that Durruti was condemning a practice he once participated in.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He held that, as the CNT counted more than 1 million members, individual actions were no longer acceptable; conditions demanded only collective action.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In August 1935, he was transferred to La Model prison in Valencia. On 11 September 1935, he wrote to José Mira, affirming his position that the CNT ought to organise towards a social revolution, rather than focusing on short-term gains and individual acts of sabotage.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In August 1935, he was transferred to La Model prison in Valencia. On 11 September 1935, he wrote to José Mira, affirming his position that the CNT ought to organise towards a social revolution, rather than focusing on short-term gains and individual acts of sabotage.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Some days later, he attended a rally in support of the Andalusian anarchist Jerónimo Misa, who was facing a death sentence for organising a prison break.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: When police attempted to arrest _____ for denouncing the government, Durruti helped him escape
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: When police attempted to arrest Ascaso for denouncing the government, Durruti helped him escape.

Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He was then arrested by the Civil Guard and transferred to Barcelona, where he was released from detention on 10 January 1936. Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: But unlike in _____, in this election, Durruti refused to advise anarchists to abstain from voting, as he hoped anarchists as a voting bloc would be able to pressure the government to release their po
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: But unlike in 1933, in this election, Durruti refused to advise anarchists to abstain from voting, as he hoped anarchists as a voting bloc would be able to pressure the government to release their political prisoners.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: On 6 _____, Durruti denounced the government's actions at a CNT meeting
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 6 March, Durruti denounced the government's actions at a CNT meeting.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: By the time of the 4th National Congress of the CNT, held in Zaragoza on 1 May _____, Durruti was looked up to as an informal leader within the organisation
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: By the time of the 4th National Congress of the CNT, held in Zaragoza on 1 May 1936, Durruti was looked up to as an informal leader within the organisation.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: Differences of opinion with another leading anarchist, _____, caused clashes between the two
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Differences of opinion with another leading anarchist, Joan Garcia Oliver, caused clashes between the two.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti thought _____'s conception of revolution resembled Bolshevism and he worried that it would create a dictatorship by the CNT-FAI
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Differences of opinion with another leading anarchist, Joan Garcia Oliver, caused clashes between the two. Garcia Oliver considered the CNT-FAI to be the revolutionary vanguard, while Durruti wanted a wholly anarchist revolution, driven forward by all popular forces, not just the CNT-FAI.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: By July _____, open conflict was brewing between the Spanish working-class and bourgeoisie, as both were radicalised against each other
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: By July 1936, open conflict was brewing between the Spanish working-class and bourgeoisie, as both were radicalised against each other.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Strike actions and factory occupations spread throughout _____ and Spain, leading Durruti to conclude that a Europe-wide revolution was in the near future
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Strike actions and factory occupations spread throughout France and Spain, leading Durruti to conclude that a Europe-wide revolution was in the near future.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The following day, he met with Enric Pérez Farràs, the commander of the Mossos d'_____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The following day, he met with Enric Pérez Farràs, the commander of the Mossos d'Esquadra.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He wanted to know what the anarchists were planning and admitted that the Catalan government would collapse, as it did in October _____, without their help
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He wanted to know what the anarchists were planning and admitted that the Catalan government would collapse, as it did in October 1934, without their help.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: When the police chief refused to give the anarchists weapons, Durruti concluded that the _____ government was planning to use them as "cannon fodder"
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He wanted to know what the anarchists were planning and admitted that the Catalan government would collapse, as it did in October 1934, without their help. When the police chief refused to give the anarchists weapons, Durruti concluded that the Catalan government was planning to use them as "cannon fodder".

Buenaventura Durruti.question: CNT unions immediately responded by seizing weapons from the port of _____, causing a standoff with the Assault Guards
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: CNT unions immediately responded by seizing weapons from the port of Barcelona, causing a standoff with the Assault Guards.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti swiftly intervened, telling the police commander _____ to disobey his orders and allow the workers to take the weaponry
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti swiftly intervened, telling the police commander Vicente Guarner to disobey his orders and allow the workers to take the weaponry.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: In order to save face, _____ only confiscated rifles that were not in working order
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti swiftly intervened, telling the police commander Vicente Guarner to disobey his orders and allow the workers to take the weaponry. In order to save face, Guarner only confiscated rifles that were not in working order.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At 23:30 on 18 July, Durruti, Ascaso and Garcia Oliver met with the _____, who they attempted to convince to disarm the police and hand over their weapons to the workers
Buenaventura Durruti.answer: Catalan Interior Minister Josep Maria Espanya
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At 23:30 on 18 July, Durruti, Ascaso and Garcia Oliver met with the Catalan Interior Minister Josep Maria Espanya, who they attempted to convince to disarm the police and hand over their weapons to the workers.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti, Ascaso and _____ sought to finish off the right-wing mutiny with an attack against the Drassanes barracks
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At 23:30 on 18 July, Durruti, Ascaso and Garcia Oliver met with the Catalan Interior Minister Josep Maria Espanya, who they attempted to convince to disarm the police and hand over their weapons to the workers.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: In the early hours of 19 July, Durruti, Ascaso and _____ went all over the city, coordinating with the different unions and defense committees
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: In the early hours of 19 July, Durruti, Ascaso and Garcia Oliver went all over the city, coordinating with the different unions and defense committees.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: During this time, Durruti was able to prevent an armed clash from breaking out between the CNT transport union and _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: During this time, Durruti was able to prevent an armed clash from breaking out between the CNT transport union and Assault Guards.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: They then returned to _____'s apartment on Carrer de Pujades, where the Nosotros group had gathered
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They then returned to Gregorio Jover's apartment on Carrer de Pujades, where the Nosotros group had gathered.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At 04:00, they received news that the _____ had risen up in Barcelona
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At 04:00, they received news that the Nationalists had risen up in Barcelona.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti met with Ascaso and _____ at the Teatre Principal, where they discussed how to gain control of the port and prevent reinforcements from being brought in by ship
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti met with Ascaso and Garcia Oliver at the Teatre Principal, where they discussed how to gain control of the port and prevent reinforcements from being brought in by ship. He was then directed to remain at the Teatre, where he would coordinate their forces for another assault, while Garcia Oliver and Ascaso led their own detachments elsewhere.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He was then directed to remain at the Teatre, where he would coordinate their forces for another assault, while _____ and Ascaso led their own detachments elsewhere
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti met with Ascaso and Garcia Oliver at the Teatre Principal, where they discussed how to gain control of the port and prevent reinforcements from being brought in by ship. He was then directed to remain at the Teatre, where he would coordinate their forces for another assault, while Garcia Oliver and Ascaso led their own detachments elsewhere.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At _____:00, Durruti arrived at the Pla de Palau, where workers' militias and Assault Guards overpowered the Spanish Army, in the first victory of the day
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At 10:00, Durruti arrived at the Pla de Palau, where workers' militias and Assault Guards overpowered the Spanish Army, in the first victory of the day.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: By 11:00, Durruti and his forces had captured _____ and fanned out to Via Laietana and Avinguda del Paral·lel
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: By 11:00, Durruti and his forces had captured La Rambla and fanned out to Via Laietana and Avinguda del Paral·lel.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: By the following day, a social revolution had swept _____, confirming Durruti's prediction that workers would respond to a right-wing coup with revolution

Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti and _____ went to the Palace of the Generalitat and met with the Catalan President
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They made their way to the Casa Cambó on Via Laietana, where the CNT Regional Secretary Mariano R. Vázquez informed Durruti and Garcia Oliver that President Lluis Companys had requested a meeting with them. Durruti and Garcia Oliver went to the Palace of the Generalitat and met with the Catalan President.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti deferred the anarchist seizure of power until after _____ was liberated from the Nationalists
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti deferred the anarchist seizure of power until after Zaragoza was liberated from the Nationalists.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti attended the inaugural meeting of the _____ as one of the representatives for the CNT
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: After meeting with Companys and the representatives of other anti-fascist parties, the anarchists moved to establish the Central Committee of Antifascist Militias of Catalonia (CCMA), which would oversee the organisation of militias to fight against the Nationalist forces. At the plenary meeting of the CNT which set up the CCMA, Garcia Oliver attempted to push for the anarchists to seize power, but his motion was defeated by advocates of collaboration with other anti-fascist political groupings.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At the meeting, Durruti confronted the Catalan nationalist _____ over an article he had written comparing the FAI to fascists
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At the meeting, Durruti confronted the Catalan nationalist Jaume Miravitlles over an article he had written comparing the FAI to fascists.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The meeting appointed Durruti as an assistant to _____, who himself was appointed to oversee the Department of War; Durruti was selected to head the transportation department
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The meeting appointed Durruti as an assistant to Garcia Oliver, who himself was appointed to oversee the Department of War; Durruti was selected to head the transportation department. When the meeting concluded, Durruti and Garcia Oliver told the Stalinist politician Joan Comorera that they remembered how the Bolsheviks had repressed anarchism in Russia and that they would not allow the Spanish Communists to treat them the same way.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Over the subsequent days, Durruti quickly came to regard the _____ as a bureaucratic organisation, which he did not want to continue participating in
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Over the subsequent days, Durruti quickly came to regard the CCMA as a bureaucratic organisation, which he did not want to continue participating in. He was then replaced on the CCMA by Marcos Alcón.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Seeking to continue the fight against the Nationalists, he put together the first militia column: the self-titled _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Seeking to continue the fight against the Nationalists, he put together the first militia column: the self-titled Durruti Column.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He was then replaced on the CCMA by _____ón
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He was then replaced on the CCMA by Marcos Alcón.

Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti clashed with his military adviser, _____ Pérez Farràs, over this form of military organisation, which Pérez Farràs believed would not function in battle
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti clashed with his military adviser, Enric Pérez Farràs, over this form of military organisation, which Pérez Farràs believed would not function in battle.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He later ended up replacing Pérez Farràs with José _____, a non-commissioned officer who better understood Durruti's anti-authoritarian philosophy
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He later ended up replacing Pérez Farràs with José Manzana, a non-commissioned officer who better understood Durruti's anti-authoritarian philosophy.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At 08:00 on 24 July _____, Durruti spoke over the radio to Barcelona's workers, asking them to supply his column with food
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At 08:00 on 24 July 1936, Durruti spoke over the radio to Barcelona's workers, asking them to supply his column with food.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The Canadian journalist _____ van Paassen reported meeting with Durruti that morning
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The Canadian journalist Pierre van Paassen reported meeting with Durruti that morning.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: "We want the revolution here in Spain, right now," he said, "not perhaps tomorrow after the next _____ war"
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: "We want the revolution here in Spain, right now," he said, "not perhaps tomorrow after the next European war".

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: It is we who built these palaces and cities, here in Spain and in _____ and everywhere
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: It is we who built these palaces and cities, here in Spain and in America and everywhere.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At 10:00, large crowds gathered on the Passeig de Gràcia to bid farewell to the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At 10:00, large crowds gathered on the Passeig de Gràcia to bid farewell to the Durruti Column.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: They quickly captured Casp and _____, the latter of which the Column established as its headquarters
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They quickly captured Casp and Burcharaloz, the latter of which the Column set up as its headquarters. Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to Burcharaloz, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to _____, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They quickly captured Casp and Burcharaloz, the latter of which the Column set up as its headquarters. Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to Burcharaloz, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: They then set off towards _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They then set off towards Zaragoza.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: On 28 July, the _____ came under heavy aerial bombardment, killing and wounding a number of militiamen
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: They quickly captured Casp and Burcharaloz, the latter of which the Column set up as its headquarters. On 28 July, the Column came under heavy aerial bombardment, killing and wounding a number of militiamen.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: There he was reunited with his partner Émilienne Morin, with whom he organised the administrative apparatus of the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 28 July, the Column came under heavy aerial bombardment, killing and wounding a number of militiamen. Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to Burcharaloz, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He also got into an argument with Pérez Farràs, who tried to use the ambush as justification for the restructuring of the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On 28 July, the Column came under heavy aerial bombardment, killing and wounding a number of militiamen. Aiming to avoid another ambush, Durruti led the Column back to Burcharaloz, where he planned to organise reconnaissance on the enemy positions.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: From the _____ town hall, Durruti gave a rousing speech to the Column
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: From the Burcharaloz town hall, Durruti gave a rousing speech to the Column.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He chided them for running from the airplanes, pointing out that they had promised to take _____ or die trying
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He chided them for running from the airplanes, pointing out that they had promised to take Zaragoza or die trying.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He reminded them of the peasants who were building libertarian communism in their rear, and that their efforts would be for naught if the _____ were victorious
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He reminded them of the peasants who were building libertarian communism in their rear, and that their efforts would be for naught if the Nationalists were victorious.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: While recognising the dangers they faced, he called on them to take advantage of their victory in _____ to strike quickly against their enemies
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: While recognising the dangers they faced, he called on them to take advantage of their victory in Barcelona to strike quickly against their enemies.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He welcomed anyone that did not want to continue fighting to give up their rifle to someone more willing, while encouraging those that remained to continue on to _____ and Iruña
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He welcomed anyone that did not want to continue fighting to give up their rifle to someone more willing, while encouraging those that remained to continue on to Zaragoza and Iruña.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: The Durruti Column then advanced along the Ebro river towards Zaragoza, but they were halted by Nationalist resistance some _____ outside the city, forcing them to dig in
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: The Durruti Column then advanced along the Ebro river towards Zaragoza, but they were halted by Nationalist resistance some 20 kilometers outside the city, forcing them to dig in.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: After consulting with _____é Villalba Rubio, Durruti agreed to keep his Column in place until reinforcements arrived
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: After consulting with Colonel José Villalba Rubio, Durruti agreed to keep his Column in place until reinforcements arrived.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: There was little movement on the front lines in early _____, which made Durruti impatient
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: There was little movement on the front lines in early August, which made Durruti impatient.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Members of the collectives had been complaining to him about a lack of technical personnel and that some of their workers had left the collectives to join the _____
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: He expelled them from the Column and the CNT, then when they did not respond to his reprimands as he had expected, he stripped them of their clothes and sent them back to Barcelona in only their underwear. Members of the collectives had been complaining to him about a lack of technical personnel and that some of their workers had left the collectives to join the Column.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Durruti sought to the wage war against the _____ and advance the revolution at the tsame time
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: Durruti sought to the wage war against the Nationalists and advance the revolution at the tsame time.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: Seeking to break the stalemate, Durruti returned to _____ and speak with the CCMA
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: On the former issue, he demanded that Ricardo Sanz send them agronomists from Barcelona; of the latter, he dismissed them from the Column so that they could return to work on the collectives, telling them it was more important to the revolution. Seeking to break the stalemate, Durruti returned to Barcelona and speak with the CCMA.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: At one checkpoint in Cervià de les _____, he posed as a rank-and-file militiaman transferring to the rearguard and requested fuel for his vehicle
Buenaventura Durruti.fact: At one checkpoint in Cervià de les Garrigues, he posed as a rank-and-file militiaman transferring to the rearguard and requested fuel for his vehicle.

Buenaventura Durruti.subject: Indian Languages
Buenaventura Durruti.question: He then went to the CCMA headquarters on the Pla de Palau and met with _____, who he found to be stressed and sleep deprived
